stem.en: How does atomic radius change from left to right across a period?
stem.et: Kuidas muutub aatomiraadius perioodis vasakult paremale?

label.en: It decreases — the growing nuclear charge pulls the same shell inward
label.et: See väheneb — kasvav tuumalaeng tõmbab sedasama kihti sissepoole

label.en: It increases, because more electrons are being added
It stays constant, since the period number does not change
label.et: See jääb samaks, sest perioodi number ei muutu

label.en: It follows atomic mass, so it rises in steps
label.et: See järgib aatommassi, seega kasvab astmeliselt
